**Минуле → тепер** (найчастіше):\nIf + *:
**Past → now** (most common):
If + **had + V3**, … **would + V**
*If I **had taken** that job, I **would be** rich now.*

**Now → past:**
If + **Past Simple** (*were* for all persons), … **would have + V3**
*If I **were** more organised, I **wouldn't have missed** the deadline.*

- **−** hadn't + V3 · wouldn't + V · wouldn't have + V3
- *I'd* = I **had** (in the condition) or I **would** (in the result)
- instead of would — **could / might**: *I **might be** married by now.*
- comma — only when the if-part comes first
І умова, і наслідок — загальні, про тепе: Both the condition and the result are general, about the present.
Іспит уже був — наслідок у минулому, том: The exam has already happened — the result is in the past, so would have V3.
В if-частині would не ставимо — лише Pas: We don't put would in the if-part — only the Past Perfect.
Змішані умовні — для «якби тоді… то зара: Mixed conditionals are for “if back then… then now” and “if I were different… then back then”. We choose them when the cause and the result are in different times: in regrets, blame and thoughts about a different life story.
Зі словом now наслідок теперішній — woul: With the word now the result is in the present — would + V, not would have V3.
Минула умова (had bought) → результат за: A past condition (had bought) → a result now (would live).
Минула умова (had learned) → результат з: A past condition (had learned) → a result now (would be).
Минула умова → If + Past Perfect: had ta: A past condition → If + Past Perfect: had taken.
Минула умова → If + Past Perfect: hadn't: A past condition → If + Past Perfect: hadn't eaten.
Минула умова → теперішній результат: wou: A past condition → a present result: would + V.
Минуле (had got) → теперішній стан (woul: The past (had got) → a present state (wouldn't be).
Минуле рішення — наслідок тепер: A past decision — a result now
Навчання вже в минулому — потрібен Past: The studying is already in the past — you need the Past Perfect, otherwise it's an imagined present situation.
The result is also in the past: would have V3.
The result is now: would + V.
Перевіряйте часову логіку: *now / today*: Check the time logic: *now / today* → would + V; *yesterday / then* → would have V3.
Постійна риса зараз (were) → минулий рез: A permanent quality now (were) → a past result: would have + V3.
Риса зараз (were) → минулий результат (w: A quality now (were) → a past result (wouldn't have shouted).
Риса зараз (weren't so lazy) → минулий р: A quality now (weren't so lazy) → a past result (last week): would have + V3 — would have passed.
Риса зараз → минулий результат: would ha: A quality now → a past result: would have + V3.
Риса характеру — наслідок тоді: A personal quality — a result back then
Риса — завжди, а наслідок — у конкретний: The quality is always there, and the result is at one particular moment in the past.
Роздуми «що було б, якби…» про вибір, пе: Thinking “what would have happened if…” about a choice, a move, a career.
A condition in the past: had + V3 (taken).
Умова — подія, яку вже не змінити; наслі: The condition is an event that can't be changed now; the result can be seen now (now, still, by now).
Умова — постійна правда про людину, насл: The condition is a permanent truth about a person, the result is a particular case in the past.
Шкодуємо про своє чи дорікаємо іншим: то: We regret our own actions or blame others: we didn't do it then — now we have the results.
Якби Тарас не був такий сором'язливий, д: Taras is so shy — otherwise he'd have asked her out long ago.
Якби батьки не переїхали до Лідса, я б ж: My parents moved to Leeds — otherwise I wouldn't know any of you.
Якби він не був такий упертий, він би ви: He's so stubborn — otherwise he'd have said sorry.
Якби ми не спізнилися на потяг зі Львова: We missed the train from Lviv — otherwise we'd be home already.
Якби ти відкладав гроші, не був би в так: You didn't save money — otherwise you wouldn't be in this situation.
Якби ти мене послухав, ми б тут не застр: You didn't listen to me — otherwise we wouldn't be stuck here.
Якби я був сміливіший, частіше висловлюв: I'm not brave enough — otherwise I'd speak up more often.
Якби я був сміливіший, я б висловився на: I'm not brave enough — otherwise I'd have spoken up at the meeting.
I didn't leave earlier — otherwise I'd be there already.
I didn't leave earlier — otherwise I'd have caught the train.
Якби я знав його краще, я б його запроси: I don't know him well — otherwise I'd have invited him.
Якби я ліг раніше, зараз не був би такий: I didn't go to bed earlier — otherwise I wouldn't be so tired now.
Якби я тоді купив цю квартиру, зараз жив: I didn't buy that flat then — otherwise I'd be living in the centre now.
Якби я тоді погодився на роботу в Одесі,: I said no to the job in Odesa then — otherwise I'd be living by the sea now.
